goal_001.description: Reach Sector Epsilon and discover the Primordial Core.
goal_001.name: THE GREAT EXPEDITION

goal_002.description: Perform your first Warp. Your Liras and materials reset, but you gain Exotic Matter Shards for permanent multipliers that make each run stronger.
goal_002.name: INTO THE VOID

goal_003.description: Perform 5 Warps total to fully unlock Warp Tier scaling.
goal_003.name: PRESTIGE VETERAN

goal_boost_1.description: Your grid can run hotter. Fabricate a Boost Card in the Engineering tab — it takes Advanced Circuits, Superalloy, and a Quantum Core (Sector Alpha hostiles drop them).
goal_boost_1.name: OVERCLOCK PROTOCOL

goal_boost_2.description: Open Infrastructure and INSTALL the Boost Card on a building you own — it unlocks that building's Efficiency slider up to 200%. Careful: output scales linearly, but input draw scales QUADRATICALLY (200% output = 4x input).
goal_boost_2.name: RUNNING HOT

goal_cryo_1.description: The Threshold (Sector 11) is warp-hardened — only Cryo weapons breach it. Research Cryogenic Armaments in the Warp Tech tab (prereqs: Energy Metrics, then Cryogenic Systems).
goal_cryo_1.name: FORGE CRYOGENIC ARMS

goal_cryo_2.description: Craft a Cryo Lance in the Shipyard. It needs Cryo Catalyst - farm it from Sector 10 enemies.
goal_cryo_2.name: FORGE CRYOGENIC ARMS

goal_cryo_3.description: Destroy a Warp Revenant in The Threshold (Sector 11) with your Cryo armaments.
goal_cryo_3.name: BREACH THE THRESHOLD

goal_hack_1.description: Salvaged modules can be re-forged. In the Research Lab, open the Combat category: research Kinetic Weapons Theory, then Firmware Hacking beneath it, to unlock Hack Cards — module affix crafting.
goal_hack_1.name: REWRITE THE FIRMWARE

goal_hack_2.description: Hack Cards now drop in combat. Defeat enemies until a Splice Chip drops.
goal_hack_2.name: SALVAGE A HACK CARD

goal_hack_3.description: Open the Ship Designer and drag a Splice Chip onto a Common component to awaken it into a custom module with a random affix.
goal_hack_3.name: AWAKEN A MODULE

goal_matrix_1.description: Rare, Legendary and Unique modules carry SOCKETS. In the Shipyard, craft 'Matrix Synthesis' to synthesize a Matrix Core — a gem that empowers whatever module you socket it into.
goal_matrix_1.name: ATTUNE A MATRIX CORE

goal_matrix_2.description: Open the Ship Designer and drag your Matrix Core from the Armory onto an empty socket on one of your EQUIPPED modules. Its facet bonus applies while that module stays equipped.
goal_matrix_2.name: SLOT THE CORE

m002.description: You have raw Dirt and Water and nothing to do with them. Open the Research tab and unlock Basic Engineering.
m002.name: Foundational Research

m002b.description: Unlock Basic Engineering in the Research tab.
m002b.name: Foundational Research

m003.description: Unlock Basic Engineering in the Research tab.
m003.name: Pump Master

m005.description: Open the Engineering page and process Dirt to extract 100 Silicon and 80 Iron.
m005.name: Mineral Washing

m005b.description: You have the iron and the lithium. In the Shipyard, craft 2 'Basic Battery' modules — every module you equip draws power, and these are what supply it.
m005b.name: Power Cells

m005c.description: Open the Ship Designer and equip BOTH Basic Batteries into the ship's BATTERY slots. Watch the GRID fill — now the ship can run modules.
m005c.name: Power Online

m007.description: Craft a 'Basic Thruster' in the Shipyard.
m007.name: Mobility Check

m007b.description: Open the Ship Designer, then DRAG the Basic Thruster from your Armory (right panel) onto an empty ENGINE slot.
m007b.name: Spacewalk Test

m010.description: Research 'Organic Combustion' to unlock the Industrial Kiln, Carbon Fiber, and combustion-powered generators. (The manual Charcoal Kiln needs no research.)
m010.name: Organic Combustion

m011.description: In the Engineering page, use the Charcoal Kiln to produce 50 Carbon. Copper smelting burns one Carbon per unit, and the copper run coming up needs all 50.
m011.name: Essential Carbon

m012.description: Your corvette is UNPOWERED and batteries need an electrolyte. In the Mine page, extract 100 Lithium Ore — it refines two-to-one, so this is the 50 Lithium your batteries will need.
m012.name: Lithium Discovery

m013.description: Refine 50 Lithium in the Engineering tab. Lithium is the electrolyte your ship's batteries run on — and the Battery Cells inside the shield repair kits later.
m013.name: Battery Electrolyte

m013b.description: Gather 100 Malachite Ore. It smelts two-to-one, one Carbon per unit — exactly the 50 Copper and the 50 Carbon you stocked.
m013b.name: Copper Prospecting

m013c.description: Refine 50 Copper in the Engineering tab. 20 goes into the pair of Micro-Missile Launchers you will build, the other 30 into your first Circuit Boards.
m013c.name: Conductivity

m014.description: Research 'Kinetic Weapons Theory' in the Research tree.
m014.name: Ballistics Theory

m015.description: Craft 2 'Mass Driver Mk.I' in the Shipyard.
m015.name: Prototype Arsenal

m015b.description: Open the Ship Designer and equip BOTH Mass Drivers into your two WEAPON slots — twice the guns, twice the DPS.
m015b.name: Weapons Hot

m016.description: In the Engineering page, produce 100 Ferrite Rounds to feed both your weapons.
m016.name: Kinetic Munitions

m016b.description: Equip a WEAPON and SHIELD in your Ship Designer.
m016b.name: Combat Ready

m016c.description: Open the Combat page (left sidebar). Pick a sector → a target → ENGAGE. Your Shield absorbs hits first, your Hull takes the overflow. Repair kits can auto-fire — set the threshold in Research.
m016c.name: Combat Briefing

m017.description: Defeat 1 Lunar Drone in Lunar Orbit, then click RETREAT to pull your ship out.
m017.name: Target Locked

m017a.description: Not every hostile falls to slugs. The Silicate Golem in the Asteroid Belt RESISTS kinetic fire but is WEAK TO ENERGY. In the Shipyard, craft 3 'Pulse Laser Mk.I' — your Frigate carries three weapon mounts.
m017a.name: Energy Doctrine

m017a2.description: The Pulse Laser runs on Focus Crystals. In the Engineering tab, produce 90 Focus Crystals
m017a2.name: Charge the Crystals

m017b.description: Keep builds in separate slots: click LOADOUT 2, equip all THREE Pulse Lasers there, then destroy a Silicate Golem in the Asteroid Belt.
m017b.name: Pulse Fire

m017c.description: The Derelict Frigate in Mars Debris is armored against kinetic but blows apart under EXPLOSIVE ordnance. In the Shipyard, craft 4 'Micro-Missile Launcher' — one for each of the Destroyer's four weapon mounts.
m017c.name: Explosive Doctrine

m017c2.description: The launcher fires Missiles. In the Engineering tab, produce 120 HE Missiles.
m017c2.name: Stock the Warheads

m017d.description: Click LOADOUT 3, equip all FOUR Micro-Missile Launchers there, then destroy a Derelict Frigate in Mars Debris. Kinetic / Energy / Explosive now live in Loadouts 1 / 2 / 3 — before a fight, one click swaps your WHOLE ship modules.
m017d.name: Warhead

m018t1.description: In the Mine page, extract 40 Cassiterite (tin ore). It smelts into the Tin your circuits will need.
m018t1.name: Tin Prospecting

m018t2.description: In the Engineering tab, smelt Cassiterite into 24 Tin (Sn) — the 'Tin Smelting' recipe (it also uses a little Carbon).
m018t2.name: Tin Smelting

m019.description: Craft 10 Circuit Boards in the Engineering tab — they use the Tin you just smelted, plus Copper and Silicon.
m019.name: Cybernetic Integration

m019b.description: Open your Inventory (left sidebar). Cargo is slot-limited — when it fills, new materials are LOST, not paused. Expand storage here as you grow.
m019b.name: Cargo Hold

m019c.description: Open Infrastructure (left sidebar). Buildings auto-produce in the background — always running, even offline. Build them whenever you can.
m019c.name: Background Industry

m019d.description: Construct a Solar Array in Infrastructure — it generates power and keeps running even while you're away.
m019d.name: First Foundation

m019e.description: The next research, Efficient Smelting, needs COMMON ARTIFACT — a material you don't craft or mine. When a mission names something you don't recognise, the ATLAS shows where it comes from. Open the Atlas (left sidebar), switch to the MATERIALS tab, type "Common Artifact" in the search box, and open its entry to see which enemies drop it.
m019e.name: Field Manual

m021.description: Craft 5 Battery Cells in the Engineering tab.
m021.name: Industrial Energy

m022.description: Craft a 'Basic Battery' in the Shipyard.
m022.name: Power Storage

m022b.description: Open the Ship Designer, then DRAG the Basic Battery from your Armory (right panel) onto an empty BATTERY slot.
m022b.name: Power Online

m024a1.description: Craft an 'Iron Plate' in the Shipyard for hull armor.
m024a1.name: Plate the Hull

m024a2.description: Open the Ship Designer, then DRAG the Iron Plate from your Armory onto the empty ARMOR slot. It cuts incoming hull damage.
m024a2.name: Bolt It On

m024b.description: Repair kits keep you alive in combat. In the Engineering page, craft 5 Emergency Hull Patches and 5 Basic Shield Boosters. Boosters each need a Battery Cell — craft those first.
m024b.name: Field Supplies

m024b2.description: Now equip a Hull and a Shield repair kit in your Ship Designer's consumable slots. In combat, tap the HULL / SHLD buttons to spend one and patch up.
m024b2.name: Combat Triage

m024c.description: Open the Ship Designer, then DRAG the Basic Shield from your Armory (right panel) onto an empty SHIELD slot. Incoming damage hits the shield before your hull.
m024c.name: Shields Up

m025.description: Open Research and walk the branch: 'Materials Science' → 'Organic Combustion' → 'Efficient Smelting'. The last one bills 20 Common Artifacts and 10 Circuit Boards and opens alloys.
m025.name: Refining Mastery

m025a.description: Modern foundries burn Oxygen. In the Engineering tab, run Water Electrolysis to split Water — stock 70 Oxygen. The steel run ahead burns 2 per batch.
m025a.name: Split the Water

m025b.description: Now smelt 160 Steel in the Engineering tab — the Basic-Oxygen furnace blows your Oxygen through molten Iron and Carbon. Shipwright I burns most of this stock; the Frigate frame after it takes the rest.
m025b.name: Alloy Production

m026.description: Research 'Shipwright I' for hull reinforcement. It bills 76 Steel (the stock you just smelted), 30 Circuit Boards, and 60 Common Artifacts from combat salvage — top up the circuits in Engineering before you open the node.
m026.name: Master Constructor

m026b.description: Construct an 'Industrial Frigate' in the Shipyard. Its frame needs 50 Steel and 3 Reinforced Plating — craft the plating in Engineering from Salvaged Alloy + Damaged Circuitry (Lunar Orbit drops, or the Steel/Circuit reclaim recipes).
m026b.name: Hull Modernization I

m026c.description: Defeated enemies drop gear of varying rarity. Farm Lunar Orbit until a RARE (blue) module drops — a weapon, armor or shield all count.
m026c.name: Elite Salvage

m026e.description: Defeat the Rogue Architect boss in Lunar Orbit.
m026e.name: Final Confrontation

m027.description: Research 'Asteroid Belt Authorization' in the Research tree to unlock the Asteroid Belt combat zone.
m027.name: Scanning Horizon

m027b.description: Open Bounties (left sidebar — it just unlocked). Each sector runs its own combat contract board: accept one, and kills in that sector count toward it automatically. Pays Liras + a ship module.
m027b.name: Open Contracts

m028.description: In the Mine page extract Cassiterite, then smelt it into 70 Tin in Engineering. Tin is the solder in every Circuit Board and Advanced Circuit — the electronics push ahead runs on it.
m028.name: Belt Metallurgy

m029.description: Craft 'Carbon Fiber Plate' in the Shipyard.
m029.name: Hardened Shell

m029a1.description: Research 'Advanced Materials' to unlock heavier industrial recipes. It spends Common Artifacts from combat salvage.
m029a1.name: Material Sciences

m029a2.description: Research 'Advanced Metallurgy'. It bills 200 Nickel — mine Pentlandite (just unlocked), then refine it with Carbon + Oxygen first.
m029a2.name: Structural Doctrine

m029a3.description: Craft 6 Structural Components in the Engineering tab — the universal building block of heavy industry, and one goes into every Advanced Circuit you are about to build.
m029a3.name: First Components

m029a4.description: Research 'Organic Combustion' to unlock Germanium extraction (needed for semiconductors).
m029a4.name: Chemical Heat

m029a5.description: Research 'Factory Automation' — the last gate before Advanced Circuits.
m029a5.name: Factory Lights

m029a6.description: Construct 2 Biomass Plants in Infrastructure — 1,000 kW each. The assembly line ahead draws 1,500 kW, so a single plant leaves it starved. They burn Wood, so keep a stock coming.
m029a6.name: Industrial Baseload

m029a6t.description: The industrial tier runs on titanium. In the Mine page quarry Dolomite, then run Titanium Reduction in Engineering until you hold 100 Ti — Automated Smelting takes 40 and the assembler after it takes 50.
m029a6t.name: Titanium Reduction

m029a7.description: Research 'Industrial Automation'. The Infrastructure branch runs Blast Furnace → Automated Smelting → Industrial Automation, and Automated Smelting spends 40 of your titanium. Hand-soldering ends here.
m029a7.name: Industrial Automation

m029a8.description: Commission an Electronics Assembler. It costs 25,000 Liras, 50 Titanium, 40 Circuit Boards and 12 Salvage Data — Pirate Skiffs in the Asteroid Belt sometimes carry Salvage Data, so clear Belt hostiles if you are short. It draws 1,500 kW, which your two Biomass Plants cover. It consumes Silicon, Copper and Resin from storage.
m029a8.name: The Assembly Line

m029a9.description: Accumulate 100 Circuits. The Assembler produces them while you mine, fight — or sleep. Hand-crafting still works; the line just never gets tired.
m029a9.name: Passive Supply

m029b.description: Craft 6 Advanced Circuits in the Engineering tab — Shipwright II next door spends all 6. Each one takes a Structural Component (the ones you machined), Tin, plus three that need prep: Semiconductor (Silicon + Germanium), Gold (Gold Panning — Dirt + Water), and Silver (a Zinc Reduction byproduct).
m029b.name: Complex Electronics

m030.description: Research 'Shipwright II' to unlock Destroyer-class hulls.
m030.name: Naval Expansion

m030c.description: Construct a 'Destroyer' hull in the Shipyard. Needs 100 Steel and 3 Reinforced Plating (same recipe as the Frigate) — stock Salvaged Alloy + Damaged Circuitry.
m030c.name: Hull Modernization II

m030c2.description: A Destroyer draws more power than your Zone-1 batteries supply. Fabricate 3 'Improved Battery' (Z2) and equip one per battery slot — you'll need the headroom for Zone-2 weapons.
m030c2.name: Power Refit

m030c3.description: Your Zone-1 guns barely dent Zone-2 armor. And the boss breaks the Belt's pattern: the Silicate Monolith shrugs off explosive and is WEAK TO ENERGY. Fabricate 4 'Plasma Cutter' (Z2 ENERGY) and equip one per weapon slot before the fight.
m030c3.name: Heavier Ordnance

m030d.description: Defeat the Silicate Monolith (Asteroid Belt boss) to salvage a Z2 Sector Core for the Mars Debris charter. Bosses demand a full RARE loadout — Common and Uncommon gear will not cut through. Work the Asteroid Belt BOUNTY BOARD: hunt contracts pay a GUARANTEED Rare module on claim. ENERGY hits it hardest — swap loadouts before the fight.
m030d.name: Belt Overseer

m030e.description: Research 'Mars Debris Clearance' (spends the Monolith core you just salvaged) to unlock the Mars Debris zone.
m030e.name: Mars Beachhead

m030f.description: Defeat 3 Scavenger Mechs in the Mars Debris zone.
m030f.name: Salvage Operations

m030f1.description: The Warmaster breaks the zone's pattern too: it is WEAK TO KINETIC, not energy. Fabricate 4 'Autocannon' (Z3 KINETIC) and equip one per weapon slot — swap before the fight.
m030f1.name: Zone-3 Ordnance

m030f2.description: Defeat the Martian Warmaster (Mars Debris boss) — its core decrypts the Glacier Belt charter.
m030f2.name: Warmaster's Core

m030fa.description: The Warmaster will shred Zone-2 armor. Fabricate 1 'Composite Plate' (Z3 armor) and equip one per armor slot.
m030fa.name: Zone-3 Plating

m030fb.description: Reinforce your deflectors too. Fabricate 2 'Hardened Shield' (Z3) and equip one per shield slot before the Warmaster.
m030fb.name: Zone-3 Shielding

m030g.description: Research 'Glacier Belt Expedition' (spends the Warmaster core) to unlock the Glacier Belt zone.
m030g.name: Glacier Belt Survey

m030h.description: Defeat 3 Ice Wraiths in the Glacier Belt.
m030h.name: Frozen Frontier

m030h1.description: Construct a 'Heavy Cruiser' in the Shipyard. A Destroyer frame cannot carry you through the Glacial Overseer no matter how good its modules are — the tier-4 hull more than doubles your integrity and power capacity, and adds a weapon and an armor slot. Its frame needs 15 Wreckforged Alloy: refine it in Engineering from Chondrite Alloy, Steel and Martian Relics.
m030h1.name: Hull Modernization III

m030h2.description: A Heavy Cruiser carries five weapon mounts and two armor plates, and your Zone-2 cells cannot feed them — you have been running Belt-era power since the Destroyer refit. Fabricate 3 'Mg-Ion Cell' (Z4) and equip one per battery slot.
m030h2.name: Power Refit II

m030i.description: Decrypting the Sector Alpha charter takes two Glacial Overseer cores — defeat the Glacier Belt boss twice.
m030i.name: Overseer's Core

m031.description: Research 'Sector Alpha Decryption' (consumes the Overseer cores + a stock of Superalloy — craft it in Engineering) to breach Sector Alpha.
m031.name: Alpha Decryption

m032.description: Defeat 3 Alien Frigates in Sector Alpha.
m032.name: Alpha Sector Dominance

m032a.description: The Beta Colony Charter demands three XENON HARBINGER cores. Defeat the Sector Alpha boss three times.
m032a.name: Harbinger Hunt

m032b.description: Research 'Beta Colony Charter' (consumes the Harbinger cores + a large Superalloy + Titanium stock) to unlock Sector Beta.
m032b.name: Beta Colony Charter

m032c.description: Construct a 'Battlecruiser' in the Shipyard. The Xenon Harbinger is a tier-5 fight and a Heavy Cruiser cannot carry it — the capital frame adds a sixth weapon mount, a second armor plate and a fourth battery bay.
m032c.name: Capital Doctrine

m032c2.description: A Battlecruiser's fourth battery bay is empty and your Glacier-era cells cannot feed six weapon mounts. Fabricate 4 'Mg-Ion Cell' (Z4) and equip one per battery slot.
m032c2.name: Power Refit III

m032d.description: Void Artifacts drop from Sector Alpha ships — defeat them in Combat until you collect 5.
m032d.name: Void Research

m033.description: Defeat 5 Ore Guardians in Sector Beta.
m033.name: Beta Sector Expansion

m033a1.description: Construct a 'Capital Ship' in the Shipyard. The Beta Colossus is a tier-6 fight — the capital frame carries a seventh weapon mount and a third deflector. Its keel needs 12 Xenoforged Alloy, refined in Engineering.
m033a1.name: Hull Modernization IV

m033a2.description: Four empty bays and seven weapon mounts to feed. Fabricate 4 'Reactive Core' (Z6) and equip one per battery slot — assemble them in Engineering from Sector Beta colony salvage.
m033a2.name: Power Refit IV

m033b.description: Research 'Gamma Sector Clearance' (consumes the Colossus cores + a heavy Superalloy + Tungsten stock) to unlock Sector Gamma.
m033b.name: Gamma Clearance

m033c.description: Construct a 'Dreadnought' in the Shipyard. Its blueprints sit behind 'Delta Sector Survey' research — four Sector Gamma boss cores.
m033c.name: Titan Construction

m034.description: Defeat the BETA COLOSSUS 3 times — its cores are the key to Gamma Sector Clearance.
m034.name: Break the Blockade
